title: Trustworthy e2e suite: routing fix, gating, A/B/C failure fixes, device + testctl tooling

description.summary: Make the Maestro/headless test suite produce trustworthy failures: fix device routing, add per-test timeout + brittle-selector gate, fix sec-0200/auth-0110/ba-0600, expand manage_devices + testctl.
description.motivation: Spurious/infra failures are actively harmful (CEO disputes bug count); the suite must fail only for real reasons before scaling coverage.

field_changes.new_value: 11 commits on create_test_platform. Device-routing bug FIXED+validated both platforms (e2e pins maestro --device to a resolved sim/emulator; was auto-selecting the Android emulator for iOS runs). Per-test timeout added (QA_MAESTRO_TIMEOUT_MS, default 360s, SIGKILL) after a hung test wedged --all 4h+. Brittle-selector gate added (gateBrittleSelectors / scripts/check_brittle_selectors.py): ERROR=coordinate/relative/css/traits fails the gate, RISKY=text/index-used-to-locate warns. The 3 --all failures fixed by priority: A sec-0200 (false authz failure = e2e cross-layer membership contamination; beforeAll forces role-user non-membership), B auth-0110 (assert native 'Login Failed' alert instead of a flaky form field; both platforms), C ba-0600 (seed categories + rewrite flow to walk the new category-first 5-step wizard; both platforms). manage_devices: readiness columns, --list overhaul + -v, fixed --copy double-naming, Android os_version populated. testctl status shows a recent-runs table when idle. Full --all chain ran 144/144 both platforms (no hang).
Decide testctl RESULT wording (mine: 'FAIL · 118/144 pass · 3 fail' vs your '% completion') and iterate columns / per-artifact links
Bulk-annotate (# brittle-ok:) or id-ify the 46 RISKY text/index selectors (mostly tab/modal labels) to quiet warnings
events-0500 iOS: once team instruments CreateEventScreen/LocationPicker (Trello 4Ivuvgkl), replace the coordinate swipe with a selector and drop the annotation
Optional: re-run sequential --all chain (tmp/all-chain-ios-then-android.zsh) for a clean post-fix baseline (A/B/C green; events-0500 lone iOS red)
Run /reload-plugins so the newly installed engineering skills are active in the UI

events-0500 iOS RED: upstream a11y gap — new Replit-authored CreateEventScreen/LocationPicker lack testIDs on the date/time spinner + location search; local can only work around. Tracked Trello 4Ivuvgkl
Run platforms SEQUENTIALLY: concurrent qa --all share bubble_test DB + Metro + heartbeat and collide (one died 'seed failed'). Use tmp/all-chain-ios-then-android.zsh
Android emulator (Lainey/emulator-5554) uses -gpu swiftshader_indirect + -no-window -> screenshots are BLACK; diagnose via a11y/logs, boot windowed for real pixels
manage_devices --resolve is the ONLY output the qa runner parses (bare id on stdout); --list format is free to change. The ambiguous 'last' alias was removed (use last-ios/last-android)
Brittle-selector gate marker is '# brittle-ok:' ('# blind-tap-ok:' still honored). lint-staged runs tsc --noEmit on commit; git commit commits the whole staged index
iOS 'Open in Bubble?' dialog is stale SpringBoard cruft from repeated openurl, NOT a per-run obstacle; reboot the sim to clear; baseline reconnect-metro needs no dialog tap
